answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a willow swaying against Sybil identity flooding. By requiring an agent to register unique physical traits at a designated digital knoll, the network forces a linear cost function on attackers. Scaling beyond this threshold creates a negative spiral for malicious actors, as the economic expense of acquiring verified biometric data exceeds the utility gained from controlling redundant node identities within the decentralized consensus architecture.
